deleted on 27 Sep 2026 when real payloads for those three arrived and
proved the invented formats wrong in every field that mattered — booking
id shape, amount format, even the transport (WhatsApp, not app push).
Keeping known-wrong fiction alongside the truth would only mislead.
The Playo cases below are still guesses. Playo reportedly notifies by
email; that payload has not been captured yet. Treat them as scaffolding
for the date/time scanning, not as evidence about Playo.
Real payloads live in real.json. Add them with: node tools/capture.js
